snippet.title: TRUCK DRIVER: HEADING NORTH on NINTENDO SWITCH | DLC
snippet.description:
#TruckDriver #TruckDriverSwitch #TruckingSimulator
Get ready to explore the north in Truck Driver: Heading North on Nintendo Switch on April 24, the latest DLC for the beloved Truck Driver series! This expansion takes you on an epic trucking journey through scenic Nordic-inspired environments, dense forests, and breathtaking mountain routes.

00:00: Welcome to Mangefjell
00:20: Jobs in Truck Driver HN
00:31: Garage
00:52: Improve your Driving Skills
01:07: And much more

🔴Truck Driver on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/truck-driver-switch/

With Heading North, you’ll experience brand-new challenges, including unpredictable weather, long-haul deliveries, and new trucking jobs that test your driving skills. Customize your truck with fresh paint jobs, new accessories, and powerful upgrades to tackle the demanding terrain. Meet new characters, take on exciting missions, and build your trucking career in an immersive open-world setting.

Ready to take on the toughest northern roads? Watch our gameplay, reviews, and tips on Truck Driver: Heading North, and don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more trucking adventures! 🚛❄️

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
